messages:
Priya (AE): Looping in eng and platform. NorthStar wants to POC a custom Steer3B variant next week. Need quick compatibility check: KV cache behavior, quantization path, tokenizer ops, and KMS for requests. They also asked for a rough cost delta. Attaching sample weights shortly.

Eli (ML Eng): Which quant target? q4/q8? Any RMSNorm or custom attention modules?

Priya (AE): They shipped q4 and q8 checkpoints, plus a modified RMSNorm layer. Will upload to S3: s3://northstar/poc/steer3b-steered-v2.tar.gz

Anya (Platform): We need model card, tokenizer.json, and a small conversion test. See our adapter guide: https://redwood.dev/model-adapters. Also pinging @Lee for conversion script.

Lee (Eng-ML): Quick test shows RMSNorm handled by our runtime but conversion required. Command to run locally:
```
python tools/convert_weights.py --src steer3b/weights --dest build/steer3b.bin --quant q4
```
Expect ~45min on a 32GB instance.

Matt (Security): For KMS — are they asking customer-managed keys? If so, we need an encrypted transport doc and an SE to sign the security addendum. Also ask legal for DPA implications.

Sam (Sales Eng): Pricing note: for q8 variant expect ~+18% token cost due to cache footprint. If we enable prefix caching for their common prompts, could drop ~25% cost. Need traffic profile.

Priya (AE): They expect 100k tokens/day avg, seq len ~512. Can eng provide a ballpark?

Lee (Eng-ML): Ballpark for dedicated pool with caching: $900/mo. Without caching and using q8: ~$1400/mo. Will run bench with provided weights and post perf numbers.

Anya (Platform): I'll reserve a small dedicated slot for 48 hrs to run bench. ETA: Friday EOD. :white_check_mark:

Eli (ML Eng): Heads-up: custom attention variant may need a fallback plan — if conversion fails, we can fallback to a compatible distillation we host. Need customer signoff.

Priya (AE): I'll surface fallback option to buyer; also sending them the security checklist now. Thanks.

deploy-bot: preflight scan: uploaded artifact size 12.1GB, tokenizer present, no executable flags. No immediate infra blockers.

Sam (Sales Eng): Great — once bench numbers are in, I'll update the quote and loop in solutions for SOW.

Priya (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll upload the sample and confirm bench window.
